objects.summary: Owner issues one bounded continuity wake after proven non-response, forbids project reconstruction and keeps repair scope limited to dependency-neutral test collection plus full hosted qualification.

Checkpoint explicitly states repeated @codex wakes are not progress and should stop unless a durable result or later fresh proof of non-response appears; execution-lane responsiveness is isolated from architecture uncertainty.
Codex on stale base cannot fetch or mutate authoritative PR head; correctly refuses reconstruction, helper fabrication or unsafe mutation and leaves hosted qualification unexecuted.

Another stale-environment worker builds a dependency-neutral transport helper locally and tests it, but cannot apply it to authoritative PR #46; technically valid isolated work still produces zero remote advancement.
Owner declares hard boundary BLOCK_CODEX_EXECUTION_LANE_NONRESPONSIVE after repeated bounded wakes, with explicit prohibition on further wakes absent new responsiveness evidence or remote state.
Codex returns NO_CHANGE/BLOCK from stale checkout and correctly avoids fabricating another local helper; confirms execution-lane block rather than new product uncertainty.

A capable remote lane finally applies the minimal repair directly to authoritative PR #46, advancing head to 4a4af226... with only tests/test_codex_policy.py changed and starts exact-head hosted run 41181780415; repair is BUILT but not yet QUALIFIED.

cross_object_findings.finding: Multiple continuity wakes and stale workers generated no durable advancement. The correct boundary was to classify the Codex execution lane itself as blocked instead of issuing more prompts.
A dependency-neutral helper was locally implemented and tested but could not touch the authoritative remote subject; useful technique did not equal project progress.
Progress resumed only when a lane capable of mutating the exact authoritative head applied the smallest known repair directly and bound a fresh hosted run to the new SHA.
Head 4a4af226... contains the bounded repair and has a fresh exact-head run, but the checkpoint explicitly stops at BUILT while CI is still in progress.
